oauth2.scope: user-read-playback-state user-modify-playback-state user-read-currently-playing user-read-playback-position user-read-recently-played playlist-read-private playlist-read-collaborative playlist-modify-private playlist-modify-public user-library-read user-library-modify user-follow-read user-follow-modify

search.label: Search
search.description: Searches for tracks, artists, albums, etc.

search_text.label: Search Text
search_text.description: The word or phrase you are searching for

types.label: Object Types
types.description: A JSON list of the types to search for, such as ["track", "artist"].

search.afterResponse: return {tracks: response.tracks?.items, artists: response.artists?.items, albums: response.albums?.items, playlists: response.playlists?.items};

get_playback_state.label: Get Playback State
get_playback_state.description: Retrieves the current playback state of the player

context_uri.label: Context URI
context_uri.description: Spotify URI of the context to play (album, artist, playlist)

tracks.label: Tracks
tracks.description: List of spotify track uris to play (a JSON list).

set_volume.label: Set Volume
set_volume.description: Sets the volume of the player

get_playlists.label: Get Playlists
get_playlists.description: Retrieves the list of playlists that you created or followed

all.label: All
all.description: Fetches all playlists in a single request

get_playlist_items.label: Get Playlist Items
get_playlist_items.description: Retrieves the list of items in the playlist

all.label: All
all.description: Fetches all items in a single request

get_saved_tracks.label: Get Saved Tracks
get_saved_tracks.description: Retrieves the list of saved tracks for the current user

all.label: All
all.description: Fetches all items in a single request

create_playlist.label: Create Playlist
create_playlist.description: Creates a new playlist for the current user

add_playlist_items.label: Add Items to Playlist
add_playlist_items.description: Adds tracks or episodes to the playlist

items.label: Items
items.description: URIs of the items to add (a JSON list).

remove_playlist_items.label: Remove Items from Playlist
remove_playlist_items.description: Removes tracks or episodes from the playlist

items.label: Items
items.description: URIs of the items to remove (a JSON list).

playlist_items_changed.label: Playlist Items Changed
playlist_items_changed.description: Triggers when the items of a playlist change
